tools.name: run_research
tools.title: Run AI Research
tools.description: Starts the full NeuralVerge AI research workflow (multi-step search, analysis, and structured reporting) and returns a session_id immediately. Poll get_session_status with that session_id until status is 'complete' or 'failed'.

instructions.description: Main research task, in natural language.

search_enabled.description: Whether web search is enabled during research.

deepsearch_model.description: Model used for the deep research step.

finalizer_model.description: Model used to finalize the report.

extract_schema_json.description: JSON-encoded schema string describing the desired structured output.

tools.name: get_session_status
tools.title: Get Session Status
tools.description: Returns the current status of an AI Research session (queued/running/complete/failed) and the final result (human-readable summary plus machine-readable JSON) once processing completes.

tools.name: run_search
tools.title: Run Web Search
tools.description: Runs a synchronous web search and returns a structured list of ranked results (title, url, snippet) immediately, without polling.

tools.name: run_extract
tools.title: Run AI Extract
tools.description: Loads a webpage by URL and extracts structured data from it according to natural-language instructions and/or a JSON schema. Synchronous — returns the result immediately.

url.description: URL of the page to load and extract data from.

instructions.description: Natural-language description of what to extract.

extract_schema_json.description: JSON-encoded schema string for the extraction shape.

tools.name: run_linkedin_email
tools.title: LinkedIn Profile + Email Lookup
tools.description: Looks up a LinkedIn profile by its full profile URL and returns contact details, including an email address when available.

username.description: Full LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/john-doe/

tools.name: run_linkedin_domain
tools.title: LinkedIn Profile by Name + Domain
tools.description: Finds a LinkedIn profile matching a company name or domain plus a full name.

company_or_domain.description: Company name or domain, e.g. openai.com

full_name.description: Full name of the person to find.

tools.name: run_linkedin_company_search
tools.title: LinkedIn Company Search
tools.description: Searches LinkedIn companies by a text query with optional filters (size, industry, location).

maxItems.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: run_linkedin_people_search
tools.title: LinkedIn People Search
tools.description: Searches LinkedIn people using an optional free-text query and a rich set of advanced filters (company, title, seniority, location, experience, industry).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: run_linkedin_company_employee
tools.title: LinkedIn Company Employee Search
tools.description: Searches LinkedIn employees of one or more given companies, using the same people-style filters as run_linkedin_people_search.

companies.description: LinkedIn company URLs or names to search employees of.

tools.name: run_email_enrichment
tools.title: Email Enrichment
tools.description: Enriches a known email address with associated profile data (name, phone, company, position, LinkedIn/X profiles) when available.

tools.name: run_email_validation
tools.title: Email Validation
tools.description: Validates an email address and returns deliverability signals (valid/invalid/risky, catch-all detection, provider, confidence).

tools.name: run_email_finder
tools.title: Email Finder
tools.description: Finds a professional email address for a person given their company domain, first name, and last name.

tools.name: run_phone_enrichment
tools.title: Phone Enrichment
tools.description: Enriches a known phone number with associated profile data (name, email, company, LinkedIn/X profiles, carrier) when available.

phone.description: Phone number in international format, e.g. +1234567890

tools.name: run_phone_enrichment_us
tools.title: US Phone Enrichment
tools.description: Validates and enriches a US phone number with carrier, line type, activity score, litigator risk, and owner details.

tools.name: run_crunchbase_company
tools.title: Crunchbase Company Lookup
tools.description: Fetches structured company data (website, location, founding year, employees, industries, funding, description) from a Crunchbase company URL.
